description: A moderate 6km round trip hike that starts from the Chinese Mountains parking lot following along rock bluffs and eventually weaving in and out of the forest. You will be rewarded after the steady climb with some of the best views on Quadra Island. Be sure to descend via the trail as any other routes are very steep and treacherous.
directions:
Drive north from Heriot Bay along Hyacinthe Bay Road. After Walcan Road watch for the Chinese Mountain Trail sign on the left which will lead you down an old logging road to a small parking lot.

A Quadra Island Trail map is available for purchase from the visitor information centre on Quadra Island next to the Coastal Community Credit Union in Quathiaski Cove.
title: Beech's Mtn. Trail
